paragraphs.text: Innistrad: Double Feature is a booster -based compilation set that was released on January 28, 2022, in WPN stores only.

Innistrad: Double Feature was announced to combine select cards from Innistrad: Midnight Hunt and Innistrad: Crimson Vow into one unique draft experience. However, it turned out to combine all cards from the two sets. It is sold at $9.99 per booster pack.

The set features a greyscale art treatment on every card, said to be inspired by black-and-white classical monster movies. These are similar to "Eternal Night" showcase basic lands from Midnight Hunt , having colored accents to denote the card color, rarity and mana symbols . The cards have been given a special high-contrast treatment. Each card is said to have been adjusted individually to look great in black and white. The usual "rainbow" foil treatment has been swapped for a unique "silver screen" foil that is said to enhance a cinematic monochrome effect.

The Double Feature contains 534 regular cards (200 commons, 166 uncommons, 128 rares, 40 mythic rares) and includes randomly inserted premium versions of all cards. #1-267 from Innistrad: Midnight Hunt and #268-534 from Innistrad: Crimson Vow , The prerelease card card is #535. Bramble Armor Evolving Wilds and Snarling Wolf each appear twice in the list. There are no basic lands (thus also excluding the full-art lands).
Each Draft Booster contains two rares or mythic rares (one from each set), two non-foil double-faced cards (one from each set), and one silver screen foil card.
Preview Event: January 21, 2022 Exclusively at WPN Premium stores.

Commander Party : January 28-30, 2022 A one-day event where players were immersed in a story affected by their in-game choices. This event provided a faction card, a masquerade mask, and a promo card to each participant.
Prerelease card : black-and-white Endless Ranks of the Dead
All regions continue to use their Innistrad: Midnight Hunt promo packs through the Innistrad: Double Feature season.
Crimson Vow dark-frame Play Promos : Geistlight Snare , Fell Stinger and Dominating Vampire
WPN Premium events: Basic Moonlit lands from Crimson Vow .

Innistrad: Double Feature was considered a big miss. Players believed Double Feature was unnecessary; they didn't like the black-and-white aesthetic, felt WotC misled them on what the contents were going to be, and were upset that it wasn't a crafted draft experience rather than just the two sets thrown together.
